QuestInfo.name: [Black Wings] Escape Plans
QuestInfo.0: Since discovering that even #t4032775# was included in #p2154009#'s experiment, #b#p2154010##k is determined to do something.
QuestInfo.1:
#p2154010# is determined to release #t4032775# and needs your help. Find the #b#t4032782##k that #r#o8105001##k has, open the laboratory door, and rescue #b#t4032775##k!

1. Go to the Defense System Laboratory.
2. Defeat the Security System and obtain the Card Key.
3. Enter the door at the end of the Dangerous Raccoon Nest.
4. Destroy the cage and rescue the Baby Ore Muncher.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the #t4032775# to #p2154010#. #p2154010# seemed happy, but said it was too early for him to celebrate.

0.0: I want to rescue #t4032775#... With your help, it may just be possible. Please help me!

yes.0: #p2154009# has been hiding it... but I know where the key to the laboratory is. One of the #r#o8105001##k enemies should have the #b#t4032782##k. I'm not strong enough to take the Card Key from a #o8105001# but you look like you can handle it.
yes.1: Hunt #r#o8105001##k monsters until you find the #b#t4032782##k, and then enter the laboratory and rescue #b#t4032775##k. We'll figure out what to do with #b#t4032775##k after that! Please, I know you can do it!

no.0: I'm sorry... I tried to rely on you too much. If only I were more powerful...

1.0: You rescued the #t4032775#! I hope that he hasn't been hurt. Let me try to see what kind of experiments have been done on him!

yes.0: Whew, it looks like he isn't hurt. He seems timid right now but that's most likely because he is scared.
yes.1: It's too early to relax. This isn't the end of it.

item.0: You still haven't rescued #t4032775# yet? Seriously, hunt the #r#o8105001##k monsters and find the #b#t4032782##k before you enter the #blaboratory at the end of the Raccoon Mine Shaft#k and rescue #t4032775#! Please!
